Description:
GROWTH MANAGER
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Growth Manager plays a pivotal dual role at the intersection of new customer acquisition and long-term partner success. This role is responsible for driving expansion through data-driven sales and marketing strategies, while ensuring the deep engagement, retention, and growth of existing school partners. By combining the outreach excellence of an Area Manager with the relationship depth of a Customer Success Manager, the Growth Manager ensures that LEAD's mission of excellent education for every child is delivered - from the very first demo to sustained, on-ground academic impact.
ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline; deliver compelling demos and close high-value school partnerships.
Align LEAD solutions to school owner needs; negotiate contracts and ensure seamless onboarding.
Collaborate with marketing for lead generation and stay updated on competitor and industry trends.
Manage and nurture existing partner schools to ensure strong, long-term relationships and satisfaction.
Grow base business revenue through targeted upsell and cross-sell initiatives across the school portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve school NPS; drive timely renewals and support admissions growth.
Support the Academic team in implementing academic processes effectively at partner schools.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding dues from partner schools.
Conduct training for teachers and staff; track implementation quality in coordination with Academic and Sales teams.
Maintain accurate CRM records, execute BTL campaigns, and share periodic progress reports.
EXPERIENCE
Educational Background:
Graduate in B.Tech, B.Com, B.Sc, or MBA.
Professional Experience:
46 years of experience in EdTech or other industries, particularly in B2B, institutional, or corporate solution sales.
Demonstrated top quartile performance with formal recognition.
Strong ability in sales pipeline management, lead generation, contract negotiation, and client onboarding.
5+ years in customer-facing roles in EdTech (field sales, account management, or key accounts).
Experience in collections, upselling, and school relationship management.
Fluent in local language and open to travel to partnered schools.
Graduate; MBA/BTech or math background preferred.
COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
Proficient in CRM tools, product pitching, stakeholder management, and academic solution selling.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; strong customer orientation and training ability.
High ownership, solutions-driven, and collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Curious, resilient, and tech-savvy; thrives in fast-paced environments with a proactive approach.
LOCATION:
Gangtok

Description:
Job Title: Head of Department (HoD) Psychology (Professor/Associate Professor)

Role Overview
The Head of the Department of Psychology will provide visionary leadership to build a high-impact, industry-relevant, and research-driven department. The role requires balancing academic rigor with innovation, student employability, and institutional growth, while ensuring compliance with UGC norms and alignment with NEP 2020.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Academic Leadership
Develop and execute a growth strategy for the department (new programs, student intake, branding)
Design industry-aligned curriculum (e.g., clinical practice, organizational psychology, behavioural data science, counselling)
Introduce value-added certifications and interdisciplinary courses
Drive NAAC/NIRF rankings contributions and accreditation readiness

2. Program Development & Innovation
Integrate technology in psychology (e.g., psychometrics tools, data analytics, AI applications in behaviour studies)

3. Faculty Leadership & Talent Building
Implement performance-driven culture (KPIs: teaching quality, publications, student feedback, placements)
Mentor faculty for research output, consulting, and executive education

4. Research, Consulting & Revenue Generation
Build a research and consulting ecosystem (corporate training, assessments, mental health services)
Secure funded projects, consultancy assignments, and collaborations
Establish labs/centres (e.g., Behavioural Lab, Counselling Centre)
Promote publications in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals

5. Student Outcomes & Employability
Ensure strong placement and internship pipelines (Hospitals, NGOs, EdTech, corporates)
Develop career-oriented training (soft skills, psychometric testing, counselling skills)
Track and improve student success metrics (placements, higher education, certifications)

6. Industry & Institutional Partnerships
Build MoUs with hospitals, corporates, NGOs, schools, and wellness centers
Organize guest lectures, workshops, and live projects
Promote international collaborations and exchange programs

7. Administration & Operations
Manage departmental budgets with a focus on ROI and efficiency
Ensure smooth academic operations, timetabling, and compliance
Handle student grievances and maintain discipline
Contribute to university committees and strategic initiatives

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications
B.A/B.Sc & MA/M.Sc in psychology & Ph.D. in Psychology (mandatory, as per UGC/AICTE norms)
Minimum 815 years of experience in teaching/research/industry
At least 3–5 years in academic leadership roles (HoD/Program Head/Coordinator)
Strong research and publication record

Key Skills & Competencies
Leadership with a focus on growth and revenue generation
Strong networking and industry engagement skills
Ability to balance academic quality with market relevance
Data-driven decision-making and innovation mindset

The campus is surrounded by natural tranquility an ideal setting for reflective inquiry and meaningful teaching.

Description:
Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

Description:
Program Associate - District Coordination

Position Overview
The Program Associate will provide strategic and operational support to the District Administration, ensuring effective coordination and convergence among relevant departments across the assigned district and blocks.

Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct situational assessments and district-level gap analyses to identify challenges in child protection.
Undertake vulnerability mapping and facilitate the linkage of vulnerable children and families with appropriate central and state government welfare schemes.
Strengthen the functioning of child protection systems and institutions.
Support the protection and rehabilitation of children affected by child marriage, child trafficking, child labour, and other forms of exploitation.
Assist the District Administration in inspecting child protection institutions and schools to ensure compliance with applicable laws, standards, and safeguarding protocols.
Organize capacity-building workshops for government officials, frontline workers, and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct awareness and sensitization workshops at district and block levels on child protection issues, including child marriage, child labour, child trafficking, and child sexual abuse.
Facilitate interdepartmental coordination and convergence among stakeholders working on child protection.
Track progress on key indicators related to education, health, nutrition, and child protection to support timely corrective action.
Support data-driven planning, monitoring, and decision-making processes.
Document key learnings, insights, and best practices to improve programme implementation and outcomes.

Education and Experience
Graduate with 1 to 2 years of relevant work experience; or
Postgraduate/Masters degree with up to 1 year of relevant work experience.

Required Skills
Strong commitment to child protection and welfare initiatives.
Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in the local language(s) spoken in the assigned community will be preferred.

Visit all RMC vendors resources, check all materials, calibration certificates of all equipment’s, conduct mix design to reduce concrete cost.
Maintain all test reports, monthly progress report, all quality registers, files and co-ordinate with office management.
Conduct quality training to supervisors, site engineers and all labours to execute work as per out contract process and maintain the quality of work and improve the skills.
Ensure timely identification and communication of QA/QC issues to project team by raising internal NCR/observation through monthly Quality meeting.
Conducting training among the staff and workers on ongoing activities.

Conduct training sessions for site engineers, supervisors, and workers on quality practices.
Ensure proper implementation of QA standards across subcontractors and vendors.

Description:
Job Summary
ATREE is seeking an Analyst to work closely with the Policy Lead to review, analyses, study, conduct consultations, and draft recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States.
You will be a key member of a team led by the Director -The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE to external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
Responsibilities
Support the Policy Lead in delivering the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including timely reporting and tracking of success indicators.
Review rangeland, forest, and agroforestry policies and identify opportunities to strengthen mountain-specific approaches across the three landscapes.
Support development and advocacy of state-level policy action plans on restoration and agroecology (Sikkim), OECM/CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Ladakh).
Support the Policy Lead in mapping key stakeholders in policy-making and comparing existing policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific needs across the three landscapes, keeping the analysis current.
Conduct FGDs, expert interviews, and workshops on mountain-specific policies, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and supporting equitable participation of women and marginalized groups.
Identify practices or policies detrimental to climate and ecosystem resilience, and develop case studies of successful mountain-specific models or practices.
Support drafting of policy recommendations and briefing papers, and their presentation to a multi-stakeholder panel for review and feedback, delivered on schedule to support the Policy Lead.
Support the advocacy campaign to raise awareness and capacity strengthening activities, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Be part of the team compiling a comprehensive report and toolkit documenting the process, findings, recommendations, and outcomes for the IHR, and share it with stakeholders.
Support the team in creating the Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECMs/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, under the guidance of the Policy Lead and external legal counsel where required.
Support collaboration with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and contribute to the project s digital knowledge commons, helping capture and curate policy-relevant data, analysis and case studies.
Write reports and support in contributing to the learning and reporting plan, and in coordinating with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
Masters in a related field, i.e., environmental science, social sciences, natural science, ecology, natural resources management, public policy, law, or a related interdisciplinary field.
Experience Required
1 to 2 years of overall experience in policy work, with some experience in the mountains.
Strong networking skills and ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to support equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Skills to organize and communicate across levels of an organization and across geographies.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with team members.
Desirable Skills
Familiarity with data collection, coding, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Kobo Toolbox, or similar) for organizing consultation and FGD findings.
Prior exposure to national or regional mountain/biodiversity policy frameworks (e.g., National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem, State Biodiversity Action Plans) gained through coursework, internships, or prior roles.
Comfort with digital documentation and knowledge-management platforms for curating and organizing policy-relevant data and case studies.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.

Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Prepare regular reports for property owners or management. Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management. Compliance and Regulations : Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management. Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation. Project Management : Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property. Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast - paced environment. Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.
5. Employer Branding & Institutional Representation
Represent the university in corporate meetings, industry forums, and networking platforms.
Promote the university s talent pool to attract high-quality recruiters and hiring partners.
Strengthen the university s reputation as an industry-aligned institution with strong placement outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills Required:
Master s degree in Management, HR or related field.
8-12 years of experience in placements, corporate relations or industry partnerships.
Mandatory: Prior experience managing placements in universities or higher education institutions at least 3-5 years.
Proven experience in building corporate partnerships and managing recruitment engagements.
Candidates should be proficient in: Corporate relationship management
Team leadership and performance monitoring
Strategic planning and execution
Stakeholder management
Strong networking and negotiation skills
Data-driven monitoring and reporting

What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

The university integrates academic learning with practical skill-building to prepare students for employability across diverse sectors. With a mission to bridge the gap between education and workforce needs, Medhavi Skills University emphasizes experiential learning, innovation, and partnerships with industry to deliver future-ready talent.

Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client's current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.
Roles & Responsibilities
B2B Sales Process Transformation
Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.

Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve Sales productivity, decision-making, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Use appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, benchmarking, analysis, process documentation, and deliverable creation.
Apply AX Design principles to future-state process specifications by defining:
AI-agent responsibilities
Autonomy levels

Human intervention points
Human-agent handoff protocols
Quality and governance requirements

Assess market and industry trends across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
Leverage AI-assisted analytics and benchmarking tools to develop data-driven insights.

Lead or contribute to RFP responses, proposal narratives, solution approaches, process diagrams, operating models, case studies, and capability presentations.

Coach and mentor junior consultants and practitioners on B2B Sales processes, process redesign, consulting methodologies, analytics, and AI-enabled transformation.

Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!


Roles & Responsibilities:
Together with the Functional Manager and Subject Matter Experts, understand the business problem, target audiences, learning needs, and develop learning and change objectives to implement in the proposed learning solution.
Effectively collaborate with the client team to identify the solution approach and design, and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Understand the overall learning solution design and create effective training materials that map to the clients business needs.
Support the Functional Manger to develop/identify and take client buy-in on Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) measures for the project (Language Style guide, Guidelines, Checklists, templates, branding guidelines etc.) based on the project requirements.

Develop high-level and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design and create standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Develop and review training deliverables as per the agreed upon quality standards and ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Provide team members clear and effective feedback based on your reviews with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Collaborate with the different internal and client stakeholders to design and develop the relevant and effective training deliverable.
Ensure that the project meets all productivity targets as per the project plans.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Contribute to users/client organization through the Learning process.
Brief and coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for Instructor Development Workshops, Train the Trainers etc.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.

 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Education- Graduate/Post Graduate preferable with Background in HR/Learning
Professional Background - Desirable - MA/Diploma in Instructional Design or MA in Learning Sciences, MBA
8+ years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing.
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings (ILTs), Web-Based Trainings (WBTs), application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides.
Experience in working with global teams.
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently.






Additional Information:

Ability to design, develop and deliver new age learning modalities, such as gamified learning, microlearning, mobile learning would be an added advantage.
In-depth knowledge and experience to identify, select and recommend a variety of training modalities, learning strategies and technologies for a learning solution.
Ability to apply proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning.
Proficient in industry standard design / rapid authoring tools such as Articulate / Captivate / Lectora / Camtasia and SAP Enable Now / WalkMe etc. and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools (The candidate should be aware of the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.)
Exceptional design and writing skills along with strong editing and reviewing skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
Strong analytical skills
Integrated business perspective
Business acumen
Communicate effectively in visual, oral and written form.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Cross cultural competence

Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Continuous deployment and delivery using Azure DevOps
Implement the security policy so that the system is secure at operating system, database and application server level (this includes also regular patching of the entire environment 
Configure and implement appropriate Monitoring Tooling using the correct and agreed event alerts
Perform High Availability and Disaster Recovery tests with support from other IT teams
IT Risk & security controls need to be put in place and accurately documented, for this you will need to get familiar and keep up to date with the ING Information Security M Policy
Specify, design, test and deploy the runtime scripts (e.g. stop / start / purge / backup / deploy / rollback)
Implement and work with the latest tooling with a strong focus on performance, stability and security
Perform Change Management activities in order to ensure the safe deliveries from Test, to Acceptance and to Production environment

Advanced knowledge on MS SQL Server and Transact-SQL
Advanced knowledge on CI/CD, and experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Maven, Checkmarx, Jenkins, Ansible

A customer focus, with the mindset to find and resolve root causes of incidents to structurally improve the customer experience.
IT Operations/Support experience combined with analytical skills to identify root causes in workflows incidents (data, technical, functional). 
Familiarity with tools like ServiceNow, Confluence, Fortify
Experience or affinity with IT Risk (SOx, vulnerability management) and Security concepts (protocols, certificates, etc.)
Preferred Skills
Linux (RedHat Enterprise Linux (7 or 8)) is a plus
Experience with managing full-stack vendor packages, and additionally (low latency) infrastructural stack knowledge
Familiarity with Docker and orchestration for it like Kubernetes or Openshift
Functional knowledge of Financial Markets products – Interest Rates and Fixed Income derivatives

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.

Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager - Apartment Sales to drive end-to-end sales across gated apartment societies. This is a field-intensive role focused on managing the complete sales funnel-from lead generation to closures-while ensuring strong execution, customer experience, and revenue achievement.
Purpose of the Role: To drive closures in gated apartment societies by managing a full-cycle apartment sales funnel. The role involves lead generation, executing activation campaigns, maintaining sales hygiene, and achieving revenue targets aligned with operational excellence.
Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata / Noida / Gurgaon / India / Hyderabad. Reporting To: City Head. Working Days: 6 Days (Weekends Working). Weekly Off: Fixed Wednesday. Shift Timings: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Travel Requirement: High (Field Role).
Key Responsibilities
Apartment Onboarding: Identify and engage with gated societies for product/service onboarding
Drive end-to-end closures from initial pitch to installation activation
Build strong relationships with RWAs, facility managers, and key decision-makers
Sales Funnel Management: Maintain a strong and active sales pipeline with daily activity tracking
Generate leads through field visits, networking, and activation campaigns
Drive conversions through structured follow-ups and consistent engagement
Meeting CRM Hygiene: Ensure accurate and timely data entry in CRM tools
Maintain daily logs of meetings, follow-ups, and outcomes
Track funnel movement and performance metrics rigorously
Collections Recovery Management: Ensure timely collection of payments from clients
Coordinate with operations team post-installation
Track outstanding payments and proactively escalate delays
Client Experience: Ensure seamless onboarding and service delivery
Minimize escalations during installation and go-live
Act as a single point of contact for client satisfaction
Candidate Profile - Skills & Competencies
Strong field sales experience with proven relationship-building skills
Expertise in consultative and solution-based selling
High discipline in CRM usage and reporting hygiene
Strong stakeholder management (RWAs, societies, internal teams)
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally for closures
Target-driven with high ownership mindset
Mandatory Requirements
B2B Sales Background is mandatory
Must have handled end-to-end sales cycle (lead generation to deal closure)
Experience in full-cycle sales ownership is essential
Candidates from B2C sales backgrounds will not be considered
Preferred Qualifications
3-6 years of experience in B2B field sales / real estate / apartment or gated community sales
Familiarity with residential societies and local networks
Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Excel
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Willingness to travel extensively and meet daily activity benchmarks
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification: Graduate (Mandatory)
Age Limit: Up to 32 years

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking a CANDU Quality Specialist to support the delivery of world-class nuclear projects across the global CANDU portfolio.
Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.
Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies.
Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities.
Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams.
Engineering Quality
Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes.
Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.
Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records.
Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns.
Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments.
Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections.
Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure.
Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities.
Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders.
Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
About You
The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures.
They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements.
The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery.
Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects.
Essential Qualifications and Experience
Degree in Engineering and Quality Management
Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Nuclear Quality, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance Programs.
Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities.
Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Essential Technical Knowledge
Working knowledge of
CSA N299 Series
CSA N286
ASME NQA-1
ISO 9001 and ISO 19443
Nuclear Safety Culture principles
Supplier Quality Assurance
Audit and Surveillance Techniques
Design Control and Verification
Configuration Management
Quality Records and Traceability
Non-Conformance and Corrective Action Management
Working knowledge of Hexagon, AVEVA Smart 3D / E3D, and Siemens NX and domain knowledge of nuclear sector
Desirable
CQI/IRCA Lead Auditor qualification.
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent.
Experience supporting CANDU, nuclear new build, refurbishment, or life extension projects.
Experience as a QA Specialist, QA Engineer, PQAR, CQAR, or equivalent quality role.
Lean Six Sigma certification.
Experience with digital quality management and reporting tools.

Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations relevant reports.
Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.
Core Skills:
Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
LEED Accredited Professional
6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results
Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases
Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, AutoCAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Desirable but not essential
Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, SketchUp, and Rhino
Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials
What We Offer:
Varied, interesting, and meaningful work.
A hybrid working environment with flexibility and opportunities for growth.
Access to training, with career progression or lateral moves as the team expands.
The chance to work with a large, global, multidisciplinary consultancy on a mission to transform business practices.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer a 'Total Reward' package to help you thrive both in and out of the office. If you identify as having a disability, please inform us before your interview, and we will discuss any necessary adjustments.
