Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Guwahati (Lower Assam)
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Essential:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.

This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

External:
* Property Owners

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Key Responsibilities Operations Management
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
Inventory Control
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
Team Leadership

Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
Technology Utilization
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
Customer Experience Vendor Management
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.
Safety Compliance
Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.
Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.
Reporting KPIs
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.
Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.
Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Required Experience Skills
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.
Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.
Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

Position description: As a Commercial Manager, your main goal is to lead your team, drive sales, and manage the store's overall performance. Your key responsibilities include:

? Connect with Customers: Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and preferences.

5. Stock Management Operations:

? Efficient Stock Management: Ensure smooth and accurate stock processes to keep the store well-organized and prepared.

6. Staff Engagement Communication:

? Regular Briefings: Keep your team updated with regular meetings, sharing important information and recognizing their achievements.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Sales Strategy & Execution
Develop and implement region-specific GT sales plans to drive volume and value growth.
Monitor sales targets and ensure timely achievement of business objectives across territories.
Analyze market trends and competitor activities to revise sales strategies as needed.
2. Distribution & Channel Management
Expand and strengthen the distributor network to ensure optimum market coverage.
Oversee distributor ROI, stock levels, order fulfilment, and timely claim settlements.
Build strong relationships with wholesalers, retailers, and channel partners.
3. Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead a team of Sales Executives (SEs) and Sales Officers (SOs).
Set clear KPIs, review team performance regularly, and provide coaching for continuous improvement.
Conduct market visits to ensure effective field execution and team engagement.
4. Trade Marketing Execution
Implement and monitor trade promotion activities, schemes, and new product launches.
Ensure retail execution excellence visibility, merchandising, pricing, and planogram adherence.
Leverage retailer relationships to strengthen brand presence at the point of sale.
5. Sales Operations & Reporting
Track primary and secondary sales, generate region-wise sales reports and analyze performance trends.
Work closely with supply chain and logistics to ensure product availability across the region.
Maintain data accuracy in sales systems and ensure timely reporting to senior leadership.
6. Cross-functional Collaboration
Liaise with marketing, logistics, HR, finance, and administration teams for seamless business execution.
Provide market intelligence to the product and pricing teams for effective decision-making.

Preferred candidate profile
Education: Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales/Marketing preferred.
Experience: 10 - 20 of experience in General Trade Sales, preferably in the FMCG beverages or water category, with at least 3 years in a leadership role. (Preferred age: Below 40)
Languages: Assamese, English & Hindi
Regional Exposure: Strong understanding of the North East market, especially Lower Assam, Arunachal & Meghalaya.

Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow
Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
Serious about building a career in civil engineering and construction
Ready to learn both office-based technical work and site execution work
Punctual, honest, and responsible
Able to follow instructions and maintain professional discipline
Interested in residential, commercial, interior, and turnkey building projects
Comfortable working in a structured office environment
Experience
Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0 to 1 year of experience will be preferred.
Interview Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects Jorhat Head Office

Responsibilities
Lead and manage all aspects of the store's operations, including sales performance, customer service, staff management, inventory control, and financial targets.
Develop and implement strategies to maximize sales and profitability while ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
Recruit, train, and supervise a high-performing team, fostering a positive and motivating work environment.

Proficiency in retail management software, MS Office, and basic financial analysis.
Sound understanding of sales and marketing principles.
Demonstrated ability to analyze data, make informed decisions, and problem-solve effectively.
Flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Previous experience in the specific industry or product category of the store. Familiarity with inventory management systems and procedures. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.

Manpower

Training

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient

Job description

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. The new recruits will be thoroughly trained in all operations and procedures which they will be required to perform in the course of their job and in all actions that are to be taken in the event of an emergency.
Since the activity of fueling & de-fueling is done with the aid of Mobilized machinery/ equipment the person concerned should be able to drive an LMV/HTV vehicle comfortably.

Carry out into plane service including refueling and defueling (Receive refueling instructions from Shift Manager)
Conduct Quality Control checks on the fuel on mobile facilities and necessary documentation
Issue and sign fuel delivery receipts with respect to fuel supplies
Conduct in-situ field tests
Carry Sampling of Jet A-1 and forward the same to laboratories
Perform verification of in-use pressure gauges, hydrometers, etc.
Conduct periodic preventive maintenance on all equipment
Conduct minor maintenance and operations checks/works on the equipment
Coordination with customers/ DGCA Officials/ BSSPL officials in conducting Audits & inspections
Give timely, safe, and courteous into plane services to the airline customers
Sales/ stock accounting to be made at the end of each shift
Tank Lorry/ pipeline receipts of product and related stock accounting
Other Admin/ operations related works

Desired Candidate Profile
Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.
Candidates should mandatorily have a Light Motor(LMV), minimum 3 years old driving license.
Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language
Candidate should have good working knowledge of MS Office
Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.

ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

The Asian International University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
2. Create and publish engaging and relevant content for multiple social media platforms, including but not limited to, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
3. Manage and grow the company's social media presence, including daily monitoring and responding to comments, messages, and reviews.
4. Analyze and report on the success of social media campaigns, using metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and reach to continually improve and refine strategies.
5. Manage and maintain the company's social media calendar, ensuring that content is planned and scheduled in advance.
Requirements:
1. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content.
2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies.
4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 2-5 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.

International experience.

Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.

Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills

Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management

Administration Manager (Corporate)
Oversees daily office operations, facility management, vendor contracts, budgets, and administrative staff to ensure seamless business continuity.
Core Responsibilities
Office & Facility Management:
F Oversee corporate workspace allocation, building maintenance, housekeeping, utilities, security systems, and meeting room infrastructure.
F Maintain a high-end, agile office environment, optimizing hot-desking/hoteling arrangements, collaborative breakout areas, and state-of-the-art virtual meeting spaces.
Vendor & Procurement Management:
F Negotiate vendor contracts (security, travel, catering, maintenance, high-end office suppliers, facilities engineering), while tracking operational spend against strict corporate budgets. Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and manage office supply inventory.
Budget & Cost Control:
F Prepare and manage departmental operating budgets, track expenses, and identify cost-saving efficiencies.
Travel & Event Logistics:
F Oversee seamless, high-touch support for senior partners and visiting clients, including boardroom hospitality, local fine-dining coordination, and rapid response requests.
F Coordinate end-to-end logistics for high-profile client workshops, corporate retreats, case study events, and internal networking seminars.
F Supervise the travel desk handling highly fluid, last-minute global itineraries, visa processing, premium hotel partnerships, and corporate card reconciliations.
Compliance & Policy Execution:
F Enforce internal corporate policies, health and safety regulations, fire safety drills, and statutory/legal compliance.
Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting:
F Maintain digital/physical record systems, asset registers, and generate regular operational reports for senior leadership.
Confidentiality & Information Security:
F Enforce strict physical data protection protocols (e.g., clean-desk policies, secure disposal, guest access controls) to safeguard sensitive client project data.
Team Supervision:
F Hire, train, schedule, and evaluate administrative support staff, receptionists, and facilities coordinators.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business administration, Management, or a related field with 8 to 10 years of corporate administrative or facilities management experience with a strong preference for backgrounds in premium professional services (Consulting, Big 4, Legal) or 5-star hospitality corporate desks.
2. Strong command of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and workplace management or ERP/MIS tools.
3. Strong leadership and people management.
4. Vendor negotiation and contract lifecycle management.
5. Problem-solving under pressure and crisis management.
6. Flawless executive communication and stakeholder management.
7. Extreme discretion, emotional intelligence, and professional etiquette.
8. Agility to handle fast-changing schedules and urgent, last-minute requests.

Remuneration:

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in building and maintaining robust backend services that power our applications. This position requires a developer with strong experience in Golang and Python , along with hands-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure , containerization , and databases .

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go (Golang) and Python .
Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for efficient data storage and caching.
Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance and scalability issues.

3-5 years of backend development experience.
Proficiency in Golang and Python .
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis .
Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestration.
Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM).
Understanding of RESTful API design principles.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

B.E/BTech. degree in Computer Science, similar technical discipline or equivalent practical experience

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity
Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement
Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
Improve:
Planning accuracy
Inventory turns
Supplier OTD
Material availability
Production plan adherence
Lead time
OTIF
Supply Chain cost
Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile
Education :
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.
Experience
10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage
Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.
Technical Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
S&OP / IBP
MPS / MRP
Production Planning & Control
Material Planning
Procurement
Inventory Management
Warehouse Management
Supplier Management
Capacity Planning
ERP / MRP / PLM systems
Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools
Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma
Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up
Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up
Project Management
Program Management
Change Management
ERP Deployment & Go-Live
Master Data Governance
Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews
New Product Introduction (NPI)

Leadership Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Ability to manage cross-functional teams
Strong stakeholder-management skills
Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment
Strong execution discipline
Data-driven decision making
Excellent communication and escalation management
Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams
Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up.
Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth.
Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities.
Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments.

Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Job Description


Overview
Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.
Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


Requirements
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Resources/Environment/Water Management/Hydrology, with 2 to 4 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in any WQ modelling using SWMM, WASP, SWAT, Qual2k, RIOT, HEWRAT, MIKE, SAGIS-SIMCAT, Infoworks ICM.
Strong Data and Statistical analysis skills using Excel, R, SPSS, PowerBI etc.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the Water Quality studies/ Assessments.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall WQ parameters and treatment processes.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits

This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
