We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.

Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role type- IC
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.

Knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension tables.
Experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or Snowflake.
Strong understanding of Data Migration and Data Validation techniques.
Hands-on experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.

Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Preferred Skills

Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience in testing data lakes and modern data platforms.
Knowledge of automation tools for ETL validation.
Familiarity with BI reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or Business Objects.
Experience with Python or Shell scripting for data validation.

Job Description: Qualys Platform Engineer

Core Responsibilities

Architecture & Deployment Management:

Design, deploy, and manage Qualys infrastructure, including Virtual Scanner Appliances (vSAs) across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments.
Architect, test, and deploy the Qualys Cloud Agent across Enterprise Networks (Windows, Linux, macOS) ensuring zero business disruption.
Optimize scanning schedules, asset tagging, and network discovery rules to maintain an accurate, real-time asset inventory.

Integration & Automation:

Build and maintain custom scripts and automation workflows using the Qualys API to automate scan scheduling, asset tagging, and report generation.
Develop robust data pipelines to ingest Qualys vulnerability data into corporate SIEMs (Splunk, Sentinel), ticketing platforms (ServiceNow VR), and CMDBs.
Embed automated vulnerability scanning directly into DevOps CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions) to achieve "shift-left" security.

Platform Health, Scaling & Support:

Monitor the health, connectivity, and capacity of all Qualys scanner appliances and cloud agents globally.
Act as the SME engineering point of contact for troubleshooting Qualys platform issues, authentication failures, and scanning bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education & Experience:
BS in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of dedicated experience managing, configuring, and engineering the Qualys Guard / Qualys Cloud Platform at an enterprise scale.

Qualys Suite Mastery:
Deep technical expertise in core Qualys modules: VMDR (Vulnerability Management, Detection, and Response), CAR Module, PC (Policy Compliance), WAS (Web Application Scanning), CAR and AssetView/Global ITAM.
Strong understanding of authenticated vs. unauthenticated scanning, scanning engine behavior, and credential management.

Automation & Scripting:
Proficient in scripting with Python, PowerShell, or Bash to interact directly with the Qualys API (REST/XML).

Systems & Cloud Infrastructure:
Strong foundational knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems.
Solid understanding of enterprise networking concepts (firewalls, routing, NAT, load balancing) necessary to debug scanning obstacles.
Experience supporting cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and  GCP).

Preferred Qualifications
Certified Qualys Specialist (e.g., Vulnerability Management, Cloud Agent, or API certifications).
Proven experience building the Qualys Connector
Familiarity with container security scanning (Docker, Kubernetes) via Qualys Container Security.

About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)

The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:


Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To


Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies







Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.




Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning

Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.


Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile






Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, can-do attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.
What we have to offer!



Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world
Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.

Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Rewards & Recognition
Travel Allowance

About the Opportunity

Ericsson is looking for a Telecom Billing L2 Production Support Specialist to support billing and invoicing operations. The role involves 24x7 production support, billing-cycle monitoring, incident resolution, application troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Provide L2 production and operational support for telecom billing and invoicing systems.
Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly billing cycles, including bill generation, final billing, invoice generation, validation, archival, and downstream processing.

Troubleshoot job failures, processing delays, invoice issues, data discrepancies, and integration failures.

Analyze application logs, database records, input/output files, and job execution status to identify root cause and recovery actions.

Perform approved job restarts, reprocessing, reconciliation, recovery, and data-validation activities.

Monitor batch jobs, schedulers, FTP/SFTP transfers, and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Use SQL, application logs, files, and operational tools for issue analysis and billing-data validation.

Handle incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs and participate in critical incident support.

Coordinate with L3/L4 application, database, infrastructure, vendor, business, and other stakeholder teams.

Support approved changes, releases, and post-deployment validation.

Prepare RCA documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients

Description:
Role: Java Full Stack Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Bangalore (Onsite) Need Local Candidate
Notice period: Immediate to 20 days
Position- Full Time
Shift- General
Mandatory Skills:
Java, Spring boot React JS, Rest API - 4+ years of experience in developing enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and SOLID design patterns.
Proficient in Java (Core and Advanced) and Spring Boot framework.
Proficiency in building reusable components and front-end libraries using React.js.
Strong understanding of React lifecycle methods and functional components with hooks (e.g., useState, useEffect, useContext) and react json forms
Experience with state management libraries such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, or Context API.
Strong understanding of React Router for implementing navigation and routing in single-page applications (SPAs).
Familiarity with testing React components using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, or Enzyme.
Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Experience with RDBMS preferably PostgreSql and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
Good knowledge on bigdata (eg: Hive DB) and query engine tool like Trino
Good understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., JWT, OAuth, sessions).
Experience with version control systems like Git.
Good understanding of Docker and Kubernetes concepts.
Basic knowledge of Unix/Linux commands.
Understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience with tools like GitHub Actions.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS and AWS S3 object storage
Familiarity with message brokers like RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Apache MQ.
Experience using code quality tools such as SonarQube.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Princi Varshney

Job Title: .NET Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Contract Duration: 12 Months
Location: Noida, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai
Employment Type: Contract
Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced .NET Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL Server, and application development.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and web services.
Work with SQL Server, including database design, queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance applications.
Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and provide technical support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and application deployment.
Follow coding standards, best practices, and Agile development methodologies.
Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in .NET development.
Strong hands-on experience in C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Good knowledge of ASP.NET Core and Web API.
Experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, and database optimization.
Knowledge of REST APIs, Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
Experience with Git or other version control tools.
Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Good problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with Azure or AWS cloud services.
Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or Angular/React.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and microservices.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and preferred location.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.
Skills & Competencies
Business Acumen
Change Management
Conflict Management
Influencing Skills
Labour Relations
Strategy & Risk Management
Stakeholder Management

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:

Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing.

Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.

Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Job Title: Executive Assistant (Civil Construction)
Department: Executive Office / Administration
Reports To: Project Director / Managing Director / Senior Executives

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Executive Assistant with specialized experience in civil construction and government building projects. In this role, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to senior leadership. You will act as a key liaison between project managers, department heads, and government authorities, ensuring smooth document management, scheduling, and project reporting.

Key Responsibilities
Project Administration: Manage, format, and organize highly confidential government tenders, project proposals, contracts, and compliance documents.
Calendar & Schedule Management: Coordinate executive calendars, schedule high-level stakeholder meetings, and manage project site visit timelines.
Data Management & Reporting: Create, maintain, and analyze complex project trackers, budget sheets, and material inventories.
Communication & Correspondence: Draft official letters, memos, and emails to government bodies, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Document Processing: Handle heavy data entry, draft meeting minutes (MOM), and transcribe technical project briefs with high accuracy.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Industry Experience: Proven track record as an Executive Assistant or Project Coordinator within the civil construction sector, specifically dealing with government building construction.
Advanced Tech Skills: High proficiency in Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data automation) and the Google Workspace suite (specifically Google Calendar, Docs, and Sheets).
Technical Typing & Tools: Fast and accurate typing speed, with hands-on experience utilizing specialized administrative/coding scripts like abscript for document formatting or automation.
Computer Literacy: Strong overall command of computer systems, cloud storage organization, and digital workflow tools.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for professional corporate and government environments.

Education
Bachelors Degree: A graduation degree.
Graduation/Construction Background (Preferred): Graduation /Construction Management is a massive advantage, as it helps the assistant understand technical government tenders, site blueprints, and construction jargon.(Civil engineers advantage)
Computer Certifications: A certified course in Advanced Excel, Microsoft Office, or G-Suite administration, Abscript(google)
Typing Certification: A formal typing certification (e.g., 30+ words per minute) is highly preferred for handling swift government documentation.

Experience: - 5+ years
Salary- 18000 to 30000

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Completes work with a limited degree of supervision.

Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Responds to, or redirects, routine to complex inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately. Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees. Performs other routine to complex administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department. Act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
FOR FIR
Making FIR for Warranty/Contract Engines (CIL, PHP, TCL, and CECO)
Taking photos of all the Critical components and secure them till Warranty Claim closure.
Need to preserve the Failure related parts till the PQC project closure, if required need to send them to Respective plant for analysis.
Sharing the list of parts required for Partial repair of the engines at HHP RC and track them till receiving from the respective PSBU Quality team/Plant.
As and when required need to send the serviceable parts from HHP RC and Watar warehouse to the required ASM/Customer with proper packing.
Need to support the field team on technical queries.
Need to visit Watar warehouse for Parts removal and dispatch from Float /Failed engines to support the field.
FOR EDO BDO
Need to track EDO BDO s Daily basis and update in Optimus and on mails.
Track the ETA with Buyers and Vendors on regular basis till OA got closed.
Attending the EDO BDO Meetings with IPDC and Other related stakeholders.
Need to visit Plants and IPDC to resolve any kind of issues.
Audit of Depot Return parts at IPDC on monthly basis.
Preparing the Summery on PPT on weekly/monthly and Quarterly basis to present Management.
Need to Creating /reduce the P. S. Stock as per the KAM Requirements and tracking of the Parts fulfilment in P. S. Stock.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician. Completes all required on the job training hours. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities . Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development. 1. Key Skills Required
DG Set Testing Commissioning - hands-on experience in DG/engine testing.
Electrical Troubleshooting - ability to identify and rectify faults in electrical circuits, panels, wiring and protection systems.
Electrical Electronic Systems - good understanding of AC/DC circuits, sensors, relays, contactors, breakers and control systems.
Engine Electronics - basic understanding of ECU, ECM, sensors, actuators and electronic control systems.
Test Instruments - proficient in using multimeter, clamp meter, megger/insulation tester and other electrical measuring instruments.
Electrical Drawing Reading - ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and circuit diagrams.
Control Panel Knowledge - troubleshooting of DG control panels, protection circuits and monitoring systems.
Test Cell Operations - understanding of engine/DG test procedures, parameters and test-cell equipment.
Problem Solving RCA - ability to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Safety Knowledge - strong knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, PPE and safe working practices.
Documentation - maintaining test reports, check sheets, troubleshooting records and equipment history.
Computer Skills - basic MS Office/Excel and ability to work with digital testing/monitoring systems.
2. Roles Responsibilities
DG Testing Operations
Perform DG/engine testing as per defined test procedures and specifications.
Carry out pre-test inspection and verify electrical connections before starting the test.
Monitor key electrical and engine parameters during testing.
Ensure timely completion of testing to support engine dispatch requirements.
Identify abnormalities during testing and take appropriate corrective action.
Electrical Electronics Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues during engine/DG testing.
Diagnose issues related to sensors, wiring, ECU/ECM, control panels, relays, contactors, breakers and protection circuits.
Use appropriate diagnostic and electrical test equipment for fault finding.
Coordinate with Maintenance/Engineering teams for complex issues.
Quality Documentation
Ensure testing is performed as per SOP, Control Plan and Quality requirements.
Record test results accurately and maintain all required documentation.
Escalate test failures and abnormal conditions promptly.
Support RCA and corrective/preventive actions for recurring failures.
Safety
Follow all electrical and test-cell safety requirements.
Ensure proper LOTO, grounding, PPE and safe isolation before electrical intervention.
Immediately report unsafe conditions and near misses.
Maintain 5S and housekeeping in the test-cell area.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to reduce testing time, breakdowns and rework.
Support implementation of improvements in test-cell electrical systems.
Participate in problem-solving and improvement projects.
3. Ideal Candidate Profile
Diploma - Electrical / Electrical Electronics Engineering | 2-3 years experience
The candidate should be hands-on, comfortable working in a test-cell environment, strong in electrical troubleshooting, and capable of independently performing DG testing and resolving routine electrical/electronic issues.
Preferred: Experience with Cummins engines/DG sets, engine test cells, ECU/ECM-based systems, generator controls, or industrial electrical systems.
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

Description:
Wipro is seeking an AI Engineer to implement and test agent nodes on a production Agentic AI platform for a large-scale healthcare technology engagement. You will work within an established LangGraph architecture, building individual agent nodes, tool integrations, and LLM-powered processing steps under the technical direction of the Senior AI Engineer and AI Architect. This is a hands-on implementation role for an engineer who is proficient in Python and eager to work on production clinical AI at scale.

Responsibilities
Implement individual LangGraph agent nodes per agreed specifications: data retrieval, clinical assessment, evidence gathering, decision evaluation, and recommendation.
Build and maintain tool wrappers in the AI Tool Layer for enterprise clinical service integrations (claims, Rx, clinical documents, clinical model rules).
Write and optimize LLM prompt templates for relevance scoring and document processing tasks.
Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker patterns within agent nodes.
Instrument nodes with OpenTelemetry spans and structured audit log events.
Write unit and integration tests for all implemented nodes and tool integrations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards within the team.
Support integration testing, debugging, and defect resolution through the testing phase.

Required Skills & Experience
5+ years software engineering experience; 3+ year working with LLM APIs or AI application development.
Python: async programming, REST API consumption, clean modular code.
LLM integration: experience calling LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalent); function/tool calling, prompt construction, response parsing.
LangGraph or LangChain: working knowledge of agent node patterns, state management, and tool use. Production experience a strong plus.
Azure fundamentals: containerized workloads on AKS, Azure services consumption.
Testing discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and test-driven development practices.
Comfortable working within a defined architecture under senior technical direction.

Preferred Skills
Healthcare or regulated industry exposure: HIPAA awareness, PHI handling, clinical data types.
Familiarity with clinical coding systems: RxNorm, CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED-CT.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, or event-driven architectures.

Every purchase also earns reward points, and customers shopping for 1999 or more receive a Scratch Card with assured rewards ranging from 500 to 1,00,000 — creating real value and excitement for our customers.
Our vision is to grow as a trusted neighborhood supermarket brand that blends service, affordability, inclusivity, and innovation, while empowering communities, supporting women shoppers, and expanding responsibly across Odisha.

Bachelor of Engineering
Service Line
Infosys Quality Engineering
Responsibilities
Lead QA strategy and execution across projects, ensuring robust automated testing coverage and release readiness.
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based Selenium automation frameworks aligned with best practices and long-term scalability.
Design test plans, test cases, and automation suites for functional, regression, and smoke testing across applications.
Review automation code, enforce quality standards, and drive improvements in test design, stability, and execution speed.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to clarify requirements, identify risks early, and ensure testability of features.

Perform API testing using Rest Assured or equivalent tools, validating request/response flows, status codes, and data integrity.
Conduct database testing by writing and executing queries to validate data consistency, transformations, and back-end logic.

Experience leading QA teams or acting as a test/automation lead across multiple releases.

Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence quality outcomes across cross-functional teams.
Exposure to performance and API testing concepts and integrating automation into modern delivery pipelines.
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (minimum 3 years) for UI test automation, including test creation, execution, and maintenance.
Proficiency in TypeScript (or strong JavaScript with willingness to work in TypeScript) for writing clean, modular, and reusable test automation code.
Solid understanding of automation testing concepts including test design techniques, test data management, and defect lifecycle.
Preferred Skills
Technology->Automated Testing->Selenium-Java
Technology->Automated Testing->Playwright Typescript

Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.

Project Role : Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
Project Role Description : Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
Must have skills : ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD)

Summary:
As a Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or software as a service applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing application releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the system. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt the application accordingly is a key part of daily activities.

Roles Responsibilities:
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and implement application enhancements.
- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal operation.
- Document configuration changes and maintain knowledge base for future reference.
- Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices.

HRSD Snr Dev - HR Case Knowledge Management, Employee Center , Lifecycle Events

- Familiarity with APIs and integration techniques within ServiceNow platform.
- Ability to work with low-code/no-code tools to streamline application development and deployment.
- Strong problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and optimize system functionality.
- Understanding of release management processes and version control in SaaS environments.
- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD).

As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to get to the heart of customer issues, diagnose problem areas, design innovative solutions and facilitate deployment resulting in client delight.

You will develop a proposal by owning parts of the proposal document and by giving inputs in solution design based on areas of expertise.

You will plan the activities of configuration, configure the product as per the design, conduct conference room pilots and will assist in resolving any queries related to requirements and solution design

You will conduct solution/product demonstrations, POC/Proof of Technology workshops and prepare effort estimates which suit the customer budgetary requirements and are in line with organization's financial guidelines

Actively lead small projects and contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!

At least 5 years of experience in SAP Basis administration
Minimum 1 end to end SAP Basis implementation/Migration/Upgrade full life cycle.
Monitor and maintain SAP systems environments (Sandbox, Development, QA, Production and DR etc.,).
Install, configure, maintain, and support multiple SAP landscapes and 3rd party tools.
Perform core Basis functions (e.g., System Refresh, support packs, kernels, transports, DR drills)
Research and implement solutions for Basis functionality in the areas of performance monitoring, tuning,
Contribute to the architecture design of the SAP systems.
Well versed with the entire business suite of SAP & Solution Manager.
Experience in SAP HANA, OS/DB Migrations and Cloud
Experience of working with global delivery models including offshore, multi-cultural teams, functional teams & other stake holders.
SAP Certification will be added advantage.
Willing to work in 24x7 support environment.
Experience with project management
Additional Responsibility
Ability to develop value-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge
Client Interfacing skills
Project and Team management
