Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Description:
Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1–L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as “one team”.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as “one team”.
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.

Additional Requirements

Flexibility to work European Time Zone business hours; adjust schedules for peak demand and virtual learning support when required.

Description:
Position: Lead Engineer
Experience: 8-10 years

Job Summary:

We are seeking experienced Lead DevOps Platform Engineer to lead the strategy, governance, automation, and management of our GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps platforms. This role combines platform engineering, software development, DevOps architecture, enterprise governance, and technical leadership.
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, .NET (C#), Azure Functions, PowerShell, Angular and TypeScript, with a proven track record of building custom platform solutions, Azure DevOps extensions, GitHub Apps, enterprise integrations, and automation frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

Platform Administration & Governance
Lead the administration and governance of GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps and other platforms.
Manage organizations, projects, teams, enterprise policies, define and enforce repository governance, branching strategies, branch protection rules, pull request policies, and code review standards.
Implement and maintain governance controls including Secret Scanning, Dependabot, CodeQL, SonarQube integrations, and repository rulesets.
Drive standardization and adoption of DevOps best practices across engineering teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to rapidly analyze issues and deliver practical solutions.
Experience working with globally distributed teams and supporting multiple business units and engineering organizations.

Platform Engineering & Custom Development
Architect and develop enterprise-grade solutions that extend GitHub and Azure DevOps capabilities.
Design and develop scalable internal tools, services, integrations, and automation frameworks using .NET (C#).
Build reusable SDKs, API wrappers, and custom services to support platform operations and governance initiatives.
Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions using Azure Function Apps using .NET (C#).
Build event-driven and serverless solutions supporting platform automation, governance, compliance, and developer productivity.
Develop integrations leveraging Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, and Application Insights.

GitHub Application and Azure DevOps Extension Development
Design, develop, and maintain GitHub Apps and GitHub-based automation solutions.
Build integrations using GitHub REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, GitHub Actions, Webhooks, and event-driven architectures.
Create solutions supporting repository governance, onboarding, migrations, compliance, reporting, and operational automation.
Develop scalable and reusable automation frameworks supporting GitHub Enterprise administration.
Design, develop, and maintain custom Azure DevOps extensions
Build modern user experiences using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

CI/CD Architecture & DevOps Enablement
Define enterprise CI/CD standards using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
Expertise experience in designing, developing, and governing GitHub Actions workflows.
Strong expertise in workflow architecture, reusable workflows, composite actions, custom actions, environments, deployment strategies, approvals, and runner management.
Strong understanding of workflow security, secrets management, OIDC authentication, environment protection rules, and compliance controls.
Design and optimize large-scale build, deployment, and release architecture.
Implement quality gates, security controls, and compliance validation within CI/CD workflows.
Integrate DevSecOps tooling such as SonarQube, Dependabot, CodeQL, Secret Scanning, and vulnerability management platforms.
Strong experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Azure DevOps Pipelines to GitHub Actions.

Enterprise Integrations & Automation
Lead the design and implementation of integrations between GitHub, Azure DevOps, and enterprise systems.
Develop automation frameworks using PowerShell, .NET, Azure CLI, GitHub CLI, REST APIs, and GraphQL APIs.
Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and SQL development.
Automate repository provisioning, user onboarding, access governance, audit reporting, compliance checks, and operational processes.
Build self-service platform capabilities that improve developer experience and reduce manual effort.
Design and maintain operational dashboards and reporting solutions.

Migration & Platform Transformation
Lead enterprise migration initiatives of different platforms.
Define migration strategies, governance models, validation mechanisms, and automation accelerators.
Oversee repository migrations, pipeline migrations, work item migrations, and platform consolidation activities.
Provide architecture guidance and technical leadership during transformation programmers.
Drive modernization initiatives and adoption of engineering best practices.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship
Serve as the primary SME for GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps platforms.
Mentor engineers on platform engineering, automation, DevOps practices, governance, and software development.
Collaborate with engineering leadership, security teams, enterprise architects, and stakeholders.
Influence platform strategy, roadmaps, standards, and future technology investments.

Must Have Skills:

Expertise in administering GitHub Enterprise.
Expertise in .NET (C#) development, PowerShell scripting and automation.
Strong experience developing Azure Function Apps using .NET.
Strong expertise in TypeScript and Angular development.
Experience developing and maintaining custom GitHub Apps.
Strong experience with Azure Devops and Github REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, OAuth, Service Hooks, and Webhooks.
Strong experience with GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
Experience integrating SonarQube, Dependabot, CodeQL, Secret Scanning, and other DevSecOps tools.

Good To Have:

Certifications
MS certified in AZ-104 or AZ-400
GitHub Certifications
Experience source code migrations
Experience in Azure Devops Extension development
Knowledge Azure Data Factory and PowerBI

Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates

Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)

Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi

Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Job Description.

Main Responsibilities.
Capture video footage of training sessions and matches.
Edit and present footage to the coach as per the latters requirements.
Conduct analysis on opposition by using video applications or any available footage.
Work in concert with the team staff that may include goalkeeping coach, fitness trainer, physio, team manager, analyst others, keeping the goal of sustaining the teams development as top priority.

Key Performance Indicators.
Head Coach assessment.
Detailed KPI to be established and reviewed in consultation with Head Coach.
Candidate Profile.
At least 3 years of experience as video analyst in a football programme.
Past experience in NT projects will be an advantage.
Keen interest in the nuance of the game and player behaviour.
Adept at using technology and video analysis platforms.
A satisfactory level of ability in using applications like Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
Able to devise ways to present complex matters in simpler ways for youth players from varied cultures to understand.
Good communicator in Hindi and English.
Other Indian languages will be a plus.
Graduate in any discipline from a Government of India recognised institution or university.
Willing to drive own development through recognised courses and licences in his field.
Able to visualise and pursue ambitious goals that may disrupt the prevailing scenario and take Indian football to great heights.
Pleasing personality with professional attitude; willing and able to strike rapport with youth and the other staff from different cultures in an environment with language limitations.

The selected candidate will be expected to join the team any time after selection.
As the job may involve regular overseas travel, a candidate is expected to hold a valid passport and should be able to produce documents, if asked for, to prove his/her worthiness to travel.

Description:
Sr. Project Officer/Asst Manager
Number of positions 1 no.
Desired qualification Masters or UG (with experience). Encourage women with leadership to
apply.
Subject Social Sciences, Anthropology, History or Biological Sciences or any other fields with
background on society, culture, ecology, education and sustainable development.
Role and Responsibilities
The person will be responsible for planning, organizing and executing all project related
activities in coordination with the field team and project coordinator.
Will be responsible for effectively monitor the project activities and timely achievement of
the deliverables and targets.
Will be responsible to liaise and coordinate with various stakeholders to achieve project
goals.
Will be responsible for the timely collection of the field data, maintain up-to-date database
and run preliminary analysis with support from the coordinator.
Will be responsible for preparing field reports in coordination with the field team to
generate periodical reports for the project management.
Will be responsible for preparing required documents in local languages.
Key attributes required for the position
The person should be native to the State of Mizoram with fluency in Mizo and English.
Knowledge of other vernacular languages will be an added advantage.
Have at least 2-3 years of experience in community engagement for
development / sustainability / outreach or community-based conservation.
Have fair understanding of the local geographical and socio-cultural scenario of Mizoram.
Should have fair ideas and/or experiences of working with multi-stakeholders
government, non-profit, student group, community, village institution, etc.
Being able to translate from English documents to local languages will be an advantage but
not mandatory.
Must be computer savvy and have sound knowledge of using MS office, Google Drive and
other analytical tools and have hands-on experience of managing databases using MS
Excel.
Must be hardworking and able to work in difficult terrain and interior rural areas with very
basic amenities.
Location Areas around Dampa Tiger Reserve and Thorangtlang Wildlife Sanctuary in Mamit
District.
Duration of project 6 months with the possibility of extension for an additional three years.
Honorarium Commensurate to qualification and experiences.
Preferred age 26 35 years

It is recognized by the Government of India as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO)

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred
Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales

Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).

OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.

Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus

Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Coordinate with the Accounts team for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
Build strong customer relationships and strengthen the company's brand presence.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues effectively.
Guide and monitor the performance of Marketing Executives (MEs) reporting to the role.
Work closely with the RM/GM and take up additional responsibilities as required.

Requirements:
MBA (Regular) is mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in channel sales, dealer/distributor management or business development preferred.
Strong customer relationship and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of the assigned market/territory.
Leadership and team-management abilities.
Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

Description:
Job Purpose:

To independently manage day-to-day HR operations, employee relations, statutory compliance and branch administration at the Pondicherry location.

Key Responsibilities:
HR Operations: Manage onboarding, employee documentation, employee records and exit formalities.
Attendance & Leave: Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, leave applications and biometric records.
Payroll Coordination: Validate monthly attendance, overtime, leave and payroll inputs.
Statutory Compliance: Maintain statutory registers, notices and support PF, ESI, PT and other applicable compliance requirements.
Employee Engagement: Conduct employee interactions, address grievances and coordinate engagement activities.
Recruitment: Coordinate hiring, candidate screening, interviews and joining formalities.
Performance Management: Coordinate appraisal activities, goal reviews and training programme.
Branch Administration: Monitor housekeeping, dress code, pantry supplies, petty cash, office maintenance and workplace discipline.
HRMS Management: Ensure employees use the HRMS for attendance, leave applications and other HR activities.
HR Reporting: Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment and compliance status.

Required Skills:
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of HR operations and Indian labour laws.
Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS.
Strong coordination and employee-handling skills.
Ability to independently manage branch-level HR activities.

Description:
Operate slitting machines as per daily production plan and job specifications.
Understand job cards, customer specifications, roll dimensions and slitting instructions.
Set up slitting machines according to required roll width, length and quantity.
Select and install appropriate slitting knives, blades and spacers.
Set machine parameters such as web tension, winding tension, nip pressure and machine speed.
Ensure proper alignment of parent rolls and slit rolls.
Maintain accurate slitting width and roll length as per specifications.
Monitor edge quality and ensure clean, uniform slitting without burrs or uneven edges.
Ensure proper rewinding hardness, roll tightness and roll appearance.
Identify defects such as telescoping, wrinkles, uneven winding, loose winding, edge damage and roll contamination.
Ensure correct roll identification, labelling and traceability.
Minimise material wastage during setup and production.
Maintain production, wastage and machine downtime records.
Perform routine machine cleaning and basic maintenance.
Follow machine safety procedures, PPE requirements and 5S practices.

SB-Constantia is a joint venture between SB Packagings, Constantia, and Premji Invest, established in May 2023. We proudly serve leading FMCG and pharmaceutical clients such as HUL, Nestl, Dabur, Amul, Asian Paints, Kelloggs, FMC, and Mankind, among many others. With a workforce of approximately 1,800 employees, we have 7 manufacturing units across India and a state-of-the-art R&D facility. Our head office is based in Mumbai.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.

Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills

Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role

Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.

Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred

management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce

People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
