Main Responsibilities / Job Summary

1. Product manufacture
Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.
Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.
Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.
Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

2. Compliance
Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestl policies, standards and legal requirements.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.
Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.
Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

3. Maintenance integration
Coach / train, with related parties, the technicians and operators in preventive / routine maintenance activities and machinery operations.Ensure that CDM is fully integrated with factory operations and all operators / technicians understand and practice CDM.

4. Data management / Systems
Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)
Measure, analyse and control maintenance & improvement (M&I) budget and spare parts inventory by using available system / tools (NEE).Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

5. Continuous Improvement
Review process failures and execute continuous improvement activities by identifying opportunities, accessing proposals and timely implementation.
Support projects (team) by setting up / installation of new equipment, test run and ensuring readiness for mass production. Wherever required, participate in standard audits (HACCP, FSMS, GMP etc.)
Ensure that the equipment history, damage code and root cause analysis are completed correctly.

6. Knowledge management and people development
Coach and mentor, the members of team to increase productivity and efficiency by participating in daily meetings, reviewing actions.
Train the team on safety and environmental requirements and procedures.
Review and feedback to direct reports of their performance against their principal accountabilities and behavioural competencies so as to continually improve individual and team operational and/or technical capability in line with site skills and behavioural requirements.
Communicate information flows from the management to the direct reportees and vice versa.

7. Area of responsibility
a. Maintenance of filling & packing machines as core responsibility along with process machinery.
b. Maintenance budget preparation & day to day management with strong tracking with preventive mindset
c. Spares parts management for the plant, Maintenance planning & scheduling
d. Engineering contractual management including development & Day to day people management of internal & external
e. Problem solving techniques (GSTD, BDA, DMAIC etc,)
f. Project management skills will be an added advantage
g. Exposure to primary packing (horizontal flow wrapper, vertical form fills sealing machine, can/Jar filling machines, product auto feeding system into the flow wrappers), secondary packing (auto case packing, top loading, or front loading, COBOT or Robo based auto pick & place machines into grey boxes or shippers)
h. Knowledge on various type coding: Contact, Inkjet, Laser coders from reputed vendors like DOMINO, IMAJE, VIDEOJET etc.

Job Description
Job Description
This role requires > 8 years of experience working in the areas of pesticide/agrochemical formulation development and able to work in the formulation lab.
Lead the development of Crop Protection formulations
To formulate, generate scientific / technical data using established systems, procedures, and protocols in an area of work delegated by the manager.
Define the experimental programme that include the development of new pesticide formulations, procedures/standards.
To interpret data in order to make contributions to decisions in the work programme content, procedures, or problem solution.
Engages directly with other functions to co-ordinate delivery of project outputs (e. g. product biology, regulatory, procurement team, engineering team, packaging etc) with the support of a leader.
Report on work, including recommendations to project team or sub-project team leader.
Participate in regional and global technical / project teams
Will represent the formulation development work/status at every developmental stage to global peer review team and adhere to project timelines.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
To plan, organise and carry out the work programmes at the laboratory, semi-technical, pilot plant or manufacturing scale to design novel pesticide formulation options in order to:
Prove the suitability for progression through Stage C and D Evaluation and Development
Provide Product Chemistry type and or supporting data, and
Provide the formulation design input required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements to timescales and specifications agreed with the team or group leader.
Ensure the quality of Evaluation and Development formulations by arranging for biological efficacy, toxicology, and hazard assessment studies to be carried out in other Functions.
Provide advice and recommendations to allow appropriate selection of formulation manufacturing sites for individual products, together with the product design inputs required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements.
To interpret and represent to project members external to the function, experimental data and report results and conclusions obtained both orally and in written form to allow cogent and timely Stage C and D project decisions, Regulatory submissions and accurate information archiving and transfer for future commercial manufacturing activities.
To ensure that work by the job holder and subordinate staff comply with Syngenta standard operating procedures and statutory regulations (e. g. GLP or similar).
To ensure that the jobholder and subordinate staff work safely and healthy with due care for others, so that compliance with Syngenta s HSE Policy is achieved.
To invest in personal and professional development and growth, undertaking, where appropriate, training and development activities and ensuring familiarity with new research and literature.
Ensure maintaining complete confidentiality of all Syngenta intellectual property.
Interact with the global formulation community in order to better solve common problems and to define improved processes Qualifications
Qualifications
KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE and CAPABILITIES:
Critical knowledge and experience
Master s degree in Pesticide/Agrochemical chemistry must/preferable from reputed universities with strong academic records and good communication skills with > 8 years of industrial experience in field of pesticide formulation development as a formulation development chemist preferred.
Thorough knowledge of pesticides, pesticide formulation types and techniques required in formulation development.
Sound understanding of agrochemical formulations / Coformulations / Fillers is a must
Critical technical, professional, and personal capabilities
Ability to efficiently build up laboratory works and experiments
Ability to effectively participation in- and contribute to regional / global multi-functional teams
Ability to deliver to agreed timelines
Excellent operational, organisational, interpersonal and computer skills
Sensitive to different cultural environments
Self-motivating
Critical leadership capabilities
Communicative
We deliver clear messages to our stakeholders
We are keen to listen and learn
Team Oriented
We model commitment
We support team process improvement
We collaborate effectively across organisational and functional boundaries
Results Oriented
We focus on goal achievement
We stay focused
Customer Focused
We seek to understand our customers
We build collaborative relationships
Trusted
We demonstrate support for others
Critical success factors and key challenges
This role will involve taking a lead role in the development of new formulations by generating potential formulation options through the design of appropriate experimental work programs to thoroughly optimise and test these according to the formulation development process.
This will include the analysis of experimental data in order to make inputs to the decisions on the direction of the work programmes within the project.
The job holder will need to have experience of different formulation types as well as a full range of broader requirements in formulation development such as product application, manufacturing processes, etc.
To deliver highest quality results in optimal time and maintain highest standards of HSE

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing purchasing strategies, including supplier selection, negotiation, and contract management, to ensure supply chain stability and cost-effectiveness. As a Purchasing Manager / Assistant Purchasing Manager, you re not just overseeing the purchasing process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment

Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control, and procurement systems
Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and tracking purchasing performance
Familiarity with local procurement regulations, health and safety standards, and sustainability practices
Highly organized with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
Ensure that purchasing activities comply with relevant laws, regulations and company policies and uphold the hotels ethical standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee procurement operations: Manage purchasing and inventory of general merchandise to ensure adequate stock levels
Align with internal stakeholders: Collaborate with the Chef and hotel management to align purchases with hotel needs and specifications
Manage supplier relationships: Secure competitive pricing, place orders, and ensure timely delivery of goods
Ensure quality control: Review shipments to confirm products meet order specifications, grade, and quality standards
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Risk Management: To identify and manage supply chain risks, including supply disruptions, price volatility, and compliance issues.
Market Analysis: A comprehensive grasp of market trends and the capacity to anticipate price shifts and supply dynamics to inform prudent purchasing decisions.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be developing strategic marketing plans for the hotel and then overseeing the implementation and execution of the various efforts associated with the marketing plan. This might include evaluating the results of different marketing campaigns, spearheading market research efforts, or coordinating initiatives across a variety of channels. As a Marcom Manager / Assistant Marcom Manager, you re not just executing marketing campaigns to drive revenue growth - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably in hospitality
Proven expertise in digital marketing (SEO, SEM, email, social media)
Strong content creation and brand management skills
Experience in campaign planning, execution, and performance analysis
Proficiency in marketing tools and hotel systems (e.g., Salesforce, OnQ)
Excellent communication, project management, and analytical skills
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Execute hotel marketing strategies: Support the design and rollout of property-specific campaigns across digital channels, social media, and branded platforms to drive visibility and revenue.
Stay up to date on industry trends: Monitor emerging marketing tools, technologies, and consumer behaviors relevant to the hotel industry and target audiences
Report on campaign performance: Prepare and deliver monthly performance updates and marketing analyses to Sales and Revenue Management teams
Support cross-functional initiatives: Partner with department leaders to execute targeted campaigns that drive revenue and guest engagement

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Long Description: You will be the first point of contact for guests, responsible for ensuring smooth check-ins, check-outs, and addressing guest inquiries throughout their stay. You play a key role in making guests feel welcome, ensuring that all their needs are met and that any issues are resolved promptly. As a Front Office Associate , you re not just ensuring a seamless check-in and check-out process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in a guest service or front office role within the hospitality industry.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle guest inquiries and complaints professionally.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and general front office procedures.
Excellent multitasking skills and the ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
A positive attitude and a genuine passion for providing exceptional guest service.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance
Support efficient check-out: Process guest departures by verifying charges, handling payments, issuing receipts, and using the point-of-sale system accurately
Provide hotel and local knowledge: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries
Promote hotel services: Use up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize room and service revenue
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns with care and urgency, and effectively manage messages and communications

Fresher/Experienced

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :

7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.
Undertake cost-benefit analysis and economic analyses to support investment decisions for resilient infrastructure and risk mitigation measures.
Support preparation and review of financial and economic appraisal documents, models, and justification notes for government review and approval.
Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.
Educational Qualifications:
CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
1. Background of The Hans Foundation
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.
8. Equal Opportunity Statement
The Hans Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, persons with disabilities and individuals from economically and socially excluded communities who meet the requisite skills and qualifications to apply. THF does not discriminate on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other such matter.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

JOB PURPOSE
The Project Coordinator will be responsible for successful implementation of field level activities and will report to Project Manager.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:
The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:

Responsible for implementation of the project activities at the field level and coordination with other external stakeholders at the project area level.
Support the MMU team in mobilizing the community for taking up the MMU services.
Facilitate in compliance with government norms with respect to MMU operations.
Coordinate baseline survey and project monitoring.
Identify Health workers from the community and support their recruitment
process

Other tasks which may be assigned by the Project Manager from time to time.

Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.

Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.

At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.

Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).

Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.

Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Job Summary
Recruitment Associate. Location: Meghalaya, India. Contract type: Fixed term consulting contract up to . Negotiable as per experience.


Role Overview
The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. The Associate will also provide administrative support to the HR team as needed.


What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Description:
Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

Lead shift operations, coordinate with Boiler, Turbine and E&I teams, and ensure smooth power generation.
Monitor plant parameters, troubleshoot operational issues and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards.

Experience: 5-7 years in Boiler Operations
Preferred: BOE Certificate

Monitor and operate boiler systems to ensure safe, stable and efficient steam generation.

Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Operate and monitor turbine systems to ensure reliable and efficient power generation.
Handle turbine start-up, shutdown, load changes and operational troubleshooting as per SOPs.
Monitor turbine parameters and coordinate with Boiler and E&I teams for smooth plant operations.

Qualification: ITI/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct field monitoring and operation of turbine equipment and associated systems.
Perform routine equipment inspections, identify abnormalities and support troubleshooting activities.
Coordinate with the control room team during start-up, shutdown and load variation activities while maintaining safety standards.

Lead shift-wise Electrical & Instrumentation operations and ensure reliable functioning of CPP systems.
Monitor electrical and instrumentation equipment, identify faults and coordinate troubleshooting with maintenance teams.
Ensure proper preventive maintenance, safety compliance and availability of critical E&I systems.

Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering
Experience: 57 years in Instrumentation, preferably in a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and maintain instrumentation systems, control loops, sensors and field instruments across the CPP.
Troubleshoot instrumentation and control system issues to minimize downtime and ensure plant reliability.
Support calibration, preventive maintenance and smooth functioning of DCS/PLC and associated instrumentation systems.

Industry Preference: Candidates from Cement / Steel / Heavy Manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

As an ECCE Language Expert, you will support the development and contextualization of early learning content in your assigned local language. You will help ensure that video-based and activity-based content is culturally relevant, pedagogically sound and easy to understand for Anganwadi workers and caregivers in your community.
Job Overview
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya. Regular travel across districts.
Number of Positions
3 (one each for Khasi, Garo and Jaintia)
Key Responsibilities
Translate and adapt educational scripts and materials into Khasi / Garo / Jaintia, ensuring cultural and linguistic relevance
Collaborate with content experts and media producers to support scripting, dubbing and reviewing video content
Participate in user testing of content with Anganwadi workers; integrate feedback into content improvement
Support in the training of field staff (District Coordinators etc.) to ensure accurate delivery and usage of the localized content
Ensure all content aligns with MECDM ECCE priorities and national ECCE frameworks
Provide ongoing feedback to the content team for continuous improvement of content delivery and training practices
Required Qualifications
Degree or certification in ECE, Education, Child Development, or related fields
Fluency in Khasi / Garo / Jaintia (depending on position) and working proficiency in English
1-3 years of experience in ECCE curriculum development, teacher training, teaching or related education roles
Familiarity with local culture and early learning practices in Meghalaya
Comfort working with digital tools and collaborating with cross-functional teams
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in training settings
Willingness to travel to districts for user testing and training sessions

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.
